title: The four-fifths rule is not disparate impact: A woeful tale of epistemic trespassing in algorithmic fairness
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally an exploration of AI ethics and epistemology. It specifically analyzes 'epistemic trespassing' and 'deontic nuance' within the context of algorithmic fairness, critiquing the ethical harms that arise when complex legal and moral concepts are reduced to mathematical abstractions.
